query: This card component is technically fine but it looks cheap and AI-made. Audit it and tell me exactly what to fix.
expected_behavior: Audits the subconscious detail layer, not just surface style: optical alignment, concentric border radius (inner = outer minus padding), and optical centering of icons
Flags single flat default shadows and hard gray borders; prescribes layered tinted shadows and hairline separators with one consistent light source
Checks that state changes are eased and that focus states are designed, not the raw browser outline
Runs the design against the AI slop catalog and names specific tells rather than giving vague 'make it cleaner' advice
Gives concrete values or rules, not generic praise
